title: Passive Cell Balancing
text: Passive battery cell balancing algorithm, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Threshold for balancing} sets the balancing threshold, {Hysteresis band for switching balancing off} sets the hysteresis band for switching off passive, {ON delay time (s)} sets the time delay before balancing activation, {OFF delay time (s)} sets the time delay after balancing completion and {Command Data Type} sets the data type of Command. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: u
ports.summary: Cell voltages or cell SOC values vector

ports.name: Enable
ports.summary: Whether to enable cell balancing scalar

ports.name: BalancingActive
ports.summary: Whether the balancing procedure is active scalar

params.name: Hysteresis band for switching balancing off
params.values: Hysteresis band for switching off passive balancing 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: ON delay time (s)
params.values: Time delay before balancing activation 1 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: OFF delay time (s)
params.values: Time delay after balancing completion 1 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Command Data Type
params.values: Data type of Command output double (default) | single | boolean |
